claim: How the light behaves over time rather than what it looks like, and the thing that stops an i2v clip reading as a moving photograph. A director reaches for it when the scene needs a pulse the camera and the actor are not providing.
not_visual: Every option here is a modulation over time, and a still shows exactly one instant of it. flicker, pulse, breathing_glow and candle all resolve to the same lit frame; strobe and lightning would render as an arbitrary bright or dark moment that says nothing about the behaviour; passing_lights and tv_wash depend on the sweep, not the state. Any clause written here would be indistinguishable from light.motivation and would sell a claim the still cannot support. This card belongs in the LTX motion test set, one clip per option, not the still set.
